items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 9 ACs implemented; symlink-escape hardening beyond precedent explicitly rejected as out-of-scope, matching sibling artifacts.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every artifact-read path returns a named CheckResult failure rather than raising; writer's raises are caught by main() and reported without changing exit code.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No secrets/user-input here. Full symlink-escape resolve+containment considered and scoped down to a not-a-regular-file check matching the ci_supplychain_ack precedent.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: All new tests assert on outcomes (CheckResult.ok, file contents, exit codes); 19-row Test Completeness Ledger, 0 untested-testable.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single small JSON file read/write per F11 run; no loops, no unbounded fetch.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: diff_risk_recheck.py split back to 253 lines via a new sibling module (mirrors ci_supplychain.py/ci_supplychain_ack_store.py); sub-iterate-runner.md edit was net-line-neutral (497->497), avoiding an Anti-Ratchet violation.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer diff_risk_recheck.py/risk_recheck_record -> consumer risk_recheck_recording, JSON. Real subprocess round-trip probe run; malformed-artifact edge cases (the real edge-case space for a machine-only format) covered in 8 cases.
